title: 二枚の格子プレートを開いた卓上ワッフルメーカー
titleEn: Open countertop waffle iron with two gridded plates
description: カフェや軽食店のカウンターに置く、上蓋を開いた角形ワッフルメーカー模型。厚い上下プレートの表面には立体的な格子と空の窪みを設け、下部筐体、後ろのヒンジ軸と支持耳、上蓋の持ち上げハンドル、前面ダイヤルと点灯していない表示部、裏面パネルを造形しています。開き角は固定され、食品、熱や蒸気の表現はありません。開閉・加熱・温度調整機能、食品接触適合性、衛生・電気・機械安全は実装または検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.357 × 0.607 × 0.566 m、13,588三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A square waffle-iron prop for a cafe or snack counter, displayed with its upper lid fixed open. Both thick plates have modeled raised grids and empty recessed cells, supported by a lower enclosure, rear hinge pin and mounting ears, raised lid handle, front dial and unlit indicators, and underside access panel. The opening angle is fixed; food, heat and steam effects are absent. Opening, heating and temperature adjustment are not implemented, and food-contact suitability, hygiene, electrical and mechanical safety are not validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.357 × 0.607 × 0.566 m; 13,588 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
